Seven pledges were admitted into the brotherhood of Psi Upsilon in cere

landmarkwhere 40 actives and 30 area alumni enjoyed the Upsilon Chap
ter's 110th Annual Initiation Banquet. At the banquet Stephen Grabar re

Dick Wepsick shared honors for Academic Excellence. Dr. Robert E.
Kennedy, U '43, then rounded out the evening as keynote speaker. Bob's

setts Mutual Life Insurance Company. Everyone from the Upsilon wishes
Charlie well in his new position. In the meantime, the reins of the alumni
association have been ably picked up by A. Durston Dodge, Theta '44.
